_comment: 文件名 SFX_<AudioCueId> 与 SemanticAudioDirector.AudioCueId 对应,AudioCueAutoBinder 按此自动绑定。extra 组是设计文档明确提到但尚未接线的音效,先入素材库。

defaults.negative_prompt: music, melody, singing, voice, speech, talking

items.name: SFX_TelevisionPower
items.prompt: old CRT television turning on and running, steady electrical hum, 50hz mains buzz, faint static fizz, constant tone

items.name: SFX_EntryWarning
items.prompt: ominous low tension sting, deep sub bass swell rising, horror suspense drone, short build-up

items.name: SFX_DoorBreach
items.prompt: wooden apartment door violently kicked open, lock breaking, wood splintering, door slamming against wall

items.name: SFX_Gunshot
items.prompt: single pistol gunshot indoors, dry sharp crack, close range, no reverb tail, abrupt end

items.name: SFX_LoopReset
items.prompt: fast tape rewind glitch, time rewinding effect, quick pitch-down sweep ending with a soft click

items.name: SFX_TelevisionCrack
items.prompt: thick glass screen cracking, single sharp crack with electrical fizz and a short static burst

items.name: SFX_TelevisionDestroyed
items.prompt: CRT television imploding, deep muffled thud, glass shattering, electrical pop, then power dying down

items.name: SFX_EndingSilence
items.prompt: near silent room tone, faint air movement, very quiet distant hum, empty room ambience

items.name: SFX_Footstep_Bare_Wood
items.prompt: barefoot footsteps walking slowly on creaky wooden floor, soft skin pats, steady pace

items.name: SFX_Footstep_Shoes_Wood
items.prompt: hard-soled leather shoes walking slowly on wooden floor, heavy deliberate steps, menacing steady pace

items.name: SFX_Clock_Tick
items.prompt: old wall clock ticking, mechanical tick tock, steady rhythm, quiet room

items.name: SFX_Glass_Shatter
items.prompt: small glass lamp falling and shattering on wooden floor, glass shards scattering

items.name: SFX_Mirror_Crack
items.prompt: mirror glass cracking and splintering, sharp brittle cracks spreading

items.name: SFX_Wood_Splinter
items.prompt: wooden furniture cracking and splintering, plank snapping under force

items.name: SFX_Cloth_Rustle
items.prompt: heavy blanket and fabric rustling, cloth being pulled and moved

items.name: SFX_Bat_Impact
items.prompt: baseball bat striking a hard object, dull heavy whack with slight wooden knock

items.name: SFX_TV_Static_Cut
items.prompt: harsh television static burst, loud white noise, cut off abruptly

items.name: SFX_Window_Board_Break
items.prompt: wooden boards prying off a window frame, nails creaking and squeaking, planks clattering down
